name: Worst Mistakes of Addressing
proof: Restrict here to $n=2^r$ with all r-bit words present, so $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor=\log_2n=r$. Worst mistakes is at least VC dimension and at most Littlestone dimension. Both established addressing-class values are $\lfloor\log n\rfloor$, giving the claimed equality.
details: Scope: complete-code subfamily $n=2^r$, $r\ge1$. The displayed formula is not asserted for arbitrary injective encodings at other n.
